Zi-Pi Keystone Ecological Role Plot Type

Source: R/type_zipi.R
type_zipi.Rd

Creates a publication-grade Zi-Pi topological role plot for microbial co-occurrence networks and multi-omics communities (Wen et al. iMeta 2025; Guimera & Amaral Nature 2005). Partitions the \(P_i\) vs \(Z_i\) Cartesian plane into four ecological roles:

  • Peripherals (\(Z_i \le 2.5, P_i \le 0.62\)): Specialists with few inter-module links.

  • Connectors (\(Z_i \le 2.5, P_i > 0.62\)): Generalists linking distinct modules.

  • Module hubs (\(Z_i > 2.5, P_i \le 0.62\)): Highly connected specialists within their module.

  • Network hubs (\(Z_i > 2.5, P_i > 0.62\)): Super-generalists critical to network stability.

Usage

type_zipi(
  z_threshold = 2.5,
  p_threshold = 0.62,
  show_quadrants = TRUE,
  quadrant_alpha = 0.06,
  quadrant_labels = TRUE,
  label_hubs = TRUE,
  label_top = 8,
  label_size = 3,
  point_size = 2.8,
  point_alpha = 0.85,
  show_rug = TRUE,
  show_summary = TRUE,
  role_colors = NULL,
  adj_mat = NULL,
  modules = NULL
)

Arguments

z_threshold

Numeric cutoff for module hubs on \(Z_i\) (default 2.5).

p_threshold

Numeric cutoff for connectors on \(P_i\) (default 0.62).

show_quadrants

Logical. If TRUE (default), displays soft shaded background tiles for each of the 4 topological quadrants with watermark role labels.

quadrant_alpha

Numeric transparency for background quadrant tiles (default 0.05).

quadrant_labels

Logical. If TRUE (default), renders small text badges naming each quadrant.

label_hubs

Logical. If TRUE (default), labels keystone nodes (Network hubs, Module hubs, Connectors).

label_top

Integer. Maximum number of keystone taxa to label (default 8).

label_size

Numeric size for node text labels (default 3.0).

point_size

Numeric base point size, or column name for continuous sizing (default 2.8).

point_alpha

Numeric transparency for points (default 0.85).

show_rug

Logical. If TRUE (default), adds marginal rugs along axes to indicate point densities.

show_summary

Logical. If TRUE (default), adds an automated summary banner with percentage tallies.

role_colors

Optional named vector of colors for roles.

adj_mat

Optional adjacency matrix. If supplied, \(Z_i\) and \(P_i\) are computed automatically.

modules

Optional module assignments when adj_mat is provided.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# From pre-calculated Zi and Pi:
cliplot(Zi ~ Pi | Role, data = zipi_df, type = type_zipi())

# From adjacency matrix:
cliplot(type = type_zipi(adj_mat = net_adj, modules = net_mods))
} # }
